RJR INTER-OFFICE MEMORANDUM
SUJBECT: WINCHESTER TOP DRESSING
CHANGE
DATE: March 26, 1985
TO: Mr. Donald Royal 64 Blending
FROM: C. D. McGee
Flavor Technology Division
Applied R&D
Effective April 1, 1985 the top dressing for WINCHESTER will change from S-39 to S-59. The change is necessary for meet- ing the flavor protocol requested by management.
The application rate remains the same (8.82 lbs). The pounds per gallon has changed slightly. S-39 is 8.64 pounds/ gallon and S-59 is 8.61.
C.D.M. Ju C. D. McGee
/mpm
